response:
Reflection on the full archive: the mechanism is now well identified. Durable profitability = high gross margin, improving margin, and a *chronically* small working-capital accrual, with industry demeaning supplying precision. The best balanced signal so far (gen-8 Signal 1: industry-neutral margin + margin change + three-year accrual restraint) reaches FMB t=5.89, alpha 5.5%, alpha t=5.27 and Sharpe 0.585 — the only construction near the top on every metric. Remaining unexploited levers are narrow and specific: the earnings-scaled deflator and the cash-flow-preferred accrual source have each never been placed inside that industry-neutral three-leg form, and the rank-product geometry (historically the best FMB slope) has never been applied to a momentum-augmented profitability leg. This final batch runs those consolidations, plus one conjunctive geometry for long-leg purity and one distinct construction in which the improvement leg itself is measured in cash rather than accounting terms.

---SIGNAL 1---
NAME: FinalIndNeutralMomentumPercentAccrual
EXPRESSION: SUMRANK(IND_ADJ(RATIO(SUB(revt, cogs), at)), SUMRANK(IND_ADJ(DELTA(RATIO(SUB(revt, cogs), at), 1)), IND_ADJ(NEG(MA(RATIO(DELTA(SUB(SUB(act, che), SUB(lct, dlc)), 1), WINSOR(ABS(ib), 1)), 3)))))
HYPOTHESIS: Within industry, a firm with a high and rising gross margin whose reported earnings have persistently contained only a small accrual share is the purest case of profits that will not reverse.
EXPECTED_SIGN: positive
REASONING: This places the earnings-scaled deflator — which improved Sharpe in every family it entered — inside the best balanced construction in the archive, the industry-neutral level-plus-momentum-plus-chronic-accrual composite. It is the single remaining untested pairing of two corrections that have never both failed.
INTERACTION_TYPE: composite

---SIGNAL 2---
NAME: FinalIndNeutralMomentumCashFlowAccrual
EXPRESSION: SUMRANK(IND_ADJ(RATIO(SUB(revt, cogs), at)), SUMRANK(IND_ADJ(DELTA(RATIO(SUB(revt, cogs), at), 1)), IND_ADJ(MA(COALESCE(RATIO(ADD(recch, ADD(invch, apalch)), at), NEG(RATIO(DELTA(SUB(SUB(act, che), SUB(lct, dlc)), 1), at))), 3))))
HYPOTHESIS: Measuring habitual accrual behaviour from the cash-flow statement where firms report it, and from the balance sheet otherwise, validates a rising industry-relative margin at the widest available sample without introducing merger or reclassification noise.
EXPECTED_SIGN: positive
REASONING: The cash-flow-preferred accrual leg is the only construction that lifted coverage above 0.12 while keeping alpha t near 5.7, and combining it with industry demeaning and the momentum leg tests whether the archive's best result is robust to accrual data source. A comparable outcome at higher coverage would make this the preferred final signal on robustness grounds.
INTERACTION_TYPE: composite

---SIGNAL 3---
NAME: MomentumProfitAccrualRankProduct
EXPRESSION: MUL(IND_RANK(SUMRANK(RATIO(SUB(revt, cogs), at), DELTA(RATIO(SUB(revt, cogs), at), 1))), IND_RANK(NEG(MA(RATIO(DELTA(SUB(SUB(act, che), SUB(lct, dlc)), 1), at), 3))))
HYPOTHESIS: Chronic accrual restraint should scale the premium on a strong and improving profitability profile multiplicatively, so a rank product of the composite profitability percentile with the accrual-quality percentile should deliver the sharpest cross-sectional slope.
EXPECTED_SIGN: positive
REASONING: Rank products have produced the archive's two highest FMB t-statistics but always with a single-dimension profitability leg, while the momentum leg has only ever been aggregated additively; this crosses the two best design choices along orthogonal dimensions. It directly targets the one metric on which the current frontier signal is not the archive leader.
INTERACTION_TYPE: composite

---SIGNAL 4---
NAME: DualDeflatorChronicAccrualProfit
EXPRESSION: SUMRANK(IND_ADJ(RATIO(SUB(revt, cogs), at)), SUMRANK(IND_ADJ(NEG(MA(RATIO(DELTA(SUB(SUB(act, che), SUB(lct, dlc)), 1), at), 3))), IND_ADJ(NEG(MA(RATIO(DELTA(SUB(SUB(act, che), SUB(lct, dlc)), 1), WINSOR(ABS(ib), 1)), 3)))))
HYPOTHESIS: Accrual reliance is economically ambiguous in scale — it can be judged against the asset base a firm operates or against the earnings it reports — and averaging both readings gives a more reliable credibility score while doubling the weight the composite places on accrual quality relative to margin level.
EXPECTED_SIGN: positive
REASONING: Both deflators produced top-tier results but with different metric profiles (assets favoured alpha t, earnings favoured Sharpe), suggesting their measurement errors are partly independent. This also tests the implicit weighting question: whether tilting the composite two-thirds toward accrual quality strengthens or dilutes the signal.
INTERACTION_TYPE: composite

---SIGNAL 5---
NAME: CashVerifiedMarginImprovement
EXPRESSION: SUMRANK(IND_ADJ(RATIO(SUB(revt, cogs), at)), SUMRANK(IND_ADJ(DELTA(RATIO(SUB(SUB(SUB(revt, cogs), xsga), DELTA(SUB(SUB(act, che), SUB(lct, dlc)), 1)), at), 1)), IND_ADJ(NEG(MA(RATIO(DELTA(SUB(SUB(act, che), SUB(lct, dlc)), 1), at), 3)))))
HYPOTHESIS: The improvement leg should itself be cash-verified: what predicts returns is growth in operating profit net of the accruals that produced it, since an increase in accounting profit financed by working-capital buildup is not an improvement at all.
EXPECTED_SIGN: positive
REASONING: Every momentum leg tested so far measures the change in an accounting margin and relies on the separate accrual leg to discipline it, whereas here the discipline is embedded in the improvement measure itself. Dollar netting was weak as a standalone level signal but is far better suited to a change variable, where the noisy accrual is differenced against its own prior value.
INTERACTION_TYPE: novel

---SIGNAL 6---
NAME: ConjunctiveMomentumChronicQuality
EXPRESSION: MIN(IND_RANK(SUMRANK(RATIO(SUB(revt, cogs), at), DELTA(RATIO(SUB(revt, cogs), at), 1))), IND_RANK(NEG(MA(RATIO(DELTA(SUB(SUB(act, che), SUB(lct, dlc)), 1), at), 3))))
HYPOTHESIS: The long portfolio should contain only firms that clear both hurdles — strong and improving profitability, and chronically clean accruals — because a firm failing either test is not credible regardless of how well it scores on the other.
EXPECTED_SIGN: positive
REASONING: The conjunctive minimum improved steadily as the accrual leg was refined (alpha t rising from 4.35 to 5.20) and it is the geometry that literally encodes the credibility story, but it has never been given the momentum-augmented profitability leg that produced the archive's best alpha. It offers the most interpretable extreme deciles, which matters for the stability of the portfolio evidence.
INTERACTION_TYPE: conditional
